subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical bug for Google Chat Space @mention drops, or should maintainers consolidate the remaining work into the broader Google Chat Space/thread routing issue?
rationale: The classifier part has merged and shipped, but current source and fresh user evidence still point to a mention-gating/session-routing failure whose fix boundary may be a narrow bug, operator guidance, or part of broader Space routing design.

options.title: Keep as canonical Space mention bug
options.body: Use this issue for the narrow `USER_MENTION`/`botUser` detection and no-silent-drop fix, while leaving threading and all-message delivery in the broader Space issue.

options.title: Consolidate into broader Space routing
options.body: Close this only after preserving the mention-gating evidence in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44347 and making that issue the canonical remaining work.

options.title: Request fresh live repro first
options.body: Pause implementation until a maintainer or reporter supplies redacted current-main logs/probe output for a Space @mention with `botUser` configured.

recommendation.title: Keep as canonical Space mention bug
recommendation.body: Use this issue for the narrow `USER_MENTION`/`botUser` detection and no-silent-drop fix, while leaving threading and all-message delivery in the broader Space issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places this person closest to the current Google Chat ingress and mention-policy split where the remaining skip path lives.
